description:
“In a given circle to inscribe a fifteen-angled figure which shall be both equilateral and equiangular.”
— Euclid's Elements, BOOK IV • PROP. 16 (G.168)

00:00 1 · GIVEN: given circle ( A B C D )
00:19 2 · CONSTRUCT: inscribe triangle side / A C / (IV.2) & pentagon side / A B / (IV.11)
00:29 3 · CONSTRUCT: bisect arc ( B C ) at E (III.30); join / B E /, / E C /
00:40 4 · ASSERT: ( A B C ) = 5/15, ( A B ) = 3/15 → remainder ( B C ) = 2/15
01:02 5 · ∴: ( B E ) = ( E C ) = 1/15 → regular 15-gon inscribed in ( A B C D )
01:25 6 · COMMENTARY: obliquity of the ecliptic (24°) & Gauss–Wantzel constructible polygons
